name: ForestTurkey
identity: Ochre-brown turkey with golden neck and wattle, broad rounded gold-and-brown fan tail, two folded wings and two clawed feet.
individual_constraints: Warm ochre round torso with darker spots; long pale gold neck and head with no crest
Original five broad rounded tail feathers: dark ochre shafts, gold bands, pale taupe tips, one centered axial fan
One wing on each side with exactly three original tips; two thin gold shanks with rounded thighs
Front eyes round ivory, short hooked gold beak and single long gold wattle; death eyes blank round and tear
Pure back of head and neck, no eyes/beak/wattle; rear feet show heel and toes extending away
